newsitem.title: USA: Cornerstone holders convert shrs to common.
newsitem.headline: Cornerstone holders convert shrs to common.

text.p: Cornerstone Properties Inc said Monday that its two largest shareholders, Hexalon Real Estate Inc and The New York State Teachers' Retirement System, have converted their preferred shares into common shares.

Cornerstone said the conversion was based upon a predetermined average share price set at the time of the $166.5 million private placement of preferred equity to the two shareholders in November 1996.
Upon meeting the target of having an average share price in excess of $16.00 over a twenty-day period, the two were contractually obligated to convert their shares, Cornerstone said.

After the conversion, Cornerstone said it has 48,680,945 common shares outstanding, of which the Retirement System owns 6,896,550 shares, or 14.17 percent, and Hexalon owns 4,586,210 shares, or 9.42 percent.
